value.docs:
**string**: The value to set the text to.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#textset-action)*

set.docs: This is an [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) for setting a text state.

template.docs:
The `template` text platform allows you to create a text with templated values using [lambdas](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda).

*See also: [Template Text](https://esphome.io/components/text/template)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the text to set.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#textset-action)*

**string**: Manually specify the ID for code generation. At least one of **id** and **name** must be specified.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

mode.docs:
**string**: Defines how the text should be displayed in the frontend. One of `text` or `password`.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

on_value.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when a new value is published. See [`on_value`](https://esphome.io/components/text#text-on_value).

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

name.docs:
**string**: The name for the text.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

icon.docs:
**icon**: Manually set the icon to use for the text in the frontend.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

internal.docs:
**boolean**: Mark this component as internal. Internal components will not be exposed to the frontend (like Home Assistant). Only specifying an `id` without a `name` will implicitly set this to true.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

disabled_by_default.docs:
**boolean**: If true, then this entity should not be added to any client's frontend, (usually Home Assistant) without the user manually enabling it (via the Home Assistant UI). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

entity_category.docs:
**string**: The category of the entity. See [https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/#generic-properties) for a list of available options. Set to `""` to remove the default entity category.

*See also: [Text Component](https://esphome.io/components/text#optional-variables)*

source_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The source text to observe.

*See also: [Text Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor/text#configuration-variables)*
